projectTitle: Turning a Product Idea Into a Launch-Ready Brand
category: Brand Launch, Website & Organic Social Media
summary: A connected brand launch spanning identity direction, product presentation, an interactive commerce experience and organic social media.
challenge: The identity, products, website, launch story and social content all needed to feel coherent from the first public impression.
approach: Evolix designed one connected brand experience around discovery, rich product presentation, curated combinations, WhatsApp-assisted ordering and consistent launch storytelling.
outcome: Nut Delicacy moved from an early idea to a coherent launched brand with the essential digital touchpoints needed to present and sell professionally.

testimonial.quote: Nut Delicacy began as an idea, and Evolix helped us shape it into a complete brand. From the identity and website to the launch creatives and social-media presence, they supported every stage of the journey. Seeing the brand finally launch and receive such a warm response was genuinely exciting. I loved how thoughtfully everything came together.
